stories.title: Long‑end pressure is real‑yield led with a rising ACM term premium; transmission remains incomplete.
stories.whatChanged: 10Y nominal and real yields have risen and the ACM term premium increased, providing a primary rates impulse.
stories.whyItMatters: Higher real yields and an increasing term premium raise borrowing costs and can, if transmitted, widen credit spreads and weaken broad equity breadth.
stories.mechanism: Nominal 10Y move is largely accounted for by higher real yields and a measured term‑premium increase, tightening financial conditions even without immediate credit stress.
stories.conclusion: Rates and real yields are the dominant tightening force today, but credit and volatility have not yet confirmed full transmission; monitor for persistent spread widening or MOVE elevation.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Canonical MOVE/Treasury‑volatility uptick, sustained HY/IG widening, or auction absorption evidence showing dealer stress would indicate active transmission.

stories.title: Concentrated AI/semiconductor leadership is propping headline indices and masking fragility.
stories.whatChanged: AI‑infrastructure breadth and semiconductors are outperforming, with NVDA near all‑time highs and SMH strong.
stories.whyItMatters: Concentration can sustain headline indices even if broader credit or small‑cap breadth weakens, creating conditional fragility if rates pressures persist.
stories.mechanism: Strong AI/semis demand and price leadership concentrate returns, reducing the immediate visible impact of rising yields on headline breadth and credit.
stories.conclusion: AI/semiconductors are materially supporting headline performance now; this reduces near‑term visible transmission from rates to broad equity weakness but raises conditional fragility.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Breadth deterioration ex‑AI or material HY/IG spread widening would confirm that concentration no longer insulates headlines.

stories.title: Refined‑product cracks and heating oil proxies remain elevated even as crude softened.
stories.whatChanged: Distillate cracks and heating oil proxies are elevated while WTI is modestly softer, and 10Y breakeven is steady.
stories.whyItMatters: Product‑led inflation support can sustain breakevens and long yields even if crude weakens, prolonging policy‑rate sensitivity.
stories.mechanism: Regional or product‑specific tightness (distillate/heating oil) can buoy breakevens and long‑end yields independent of WTI spot direction.
stories.conclusion: Product cracks provide plausible support for breakevens and long yields today, but regional inventory and refinery data are needed to confirm persistence.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Regional PADD inventory draws, persistent refinery outages, or falling cracks would respectively confirm or weaken this story.

verified.detail: Saudi-led coalition forces said six Houthi ballistic missiles were intercepted on 24 September, with Yanbu among the targeted areas; the report also described claimed attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu.

verified.title: Duration stress is global
verified.detail: A Bloomberg global sovereign-bond yield gauge approached 4%, the highest level since 2007, supporting the view that duration pressure is global rather than solely a U.S. Treasury story.

verified.title: NBIS analyst catalyst verified
verified.detail: BNP Paribas upgraded Nebius Group from Neutral to Outperform and raised its price target from $260 to $399 on 24 September 2026, independently confirming a catalyst cited in the StockedUp transcript.

verified.title: US–China tariff cliff pushed out
verified.detail: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. and China agreed to extend their trade truce through 10 January 2027, reducing the immediate tariff-cliff risk while broader negotiations continue.

verified.title: US–Iran diplomacy is active
verified.detail: President Trump said U.S.-Iran talks were continuing during the UN General Assembly and that he believed a settlement would be reached; this verifies active diplomacy but not the transcript's specific Hormuz-for-sanctions terms.

verified.title: Diesel export-policy risk
verified.detail: The U.S. Chamber warned that restricting U.S. diesel or fuel exports could squeeze refiners and risk reducing supplies of diesel, gasoline and jet fuel, potentially worsening consumer costs.

verified.title: Late-September midterm seasonality
verified.detail: Citadel Securities' historical midterm-year path shows equities tending to weaken into around September 30 before a stronger average year-end phase; this supports late-September seasonality as context, not a forecast.

verified.title: META Muse catalyst verified
verified.detail: Meta launched its Muse personal AI agent and said it planned integration with smart glasses, independently confirming the product catalyst behind the creator's META discussion.

verified.title: RKLB defence-space catalyst verified
verified.detail: Rocket Lab said it was selected for the U.S. Space Force NITE-STAR IDIQ program, which has a ceiling of up to $981 million across participating vendors, confirming the defence-space catalyst cited by StockedUp.
